name: Dark Overlay Navigation Header with Char-Wave
layout_css: 90px overlay header toggling sticky state >20px scroll, char-wave text-shadow links (0.05s/char stagger), white dropdowns (top:75px), and 46px emerald-outlined CTA pill.
responsive_rules: 1200px collapse to mobile hamburger drawer; wave pauses on reduced motion
anti_slop_notes: Use keyboard-accessible button disclosures instead of hover-only menus.

name: Kinetic Display Hero with Radial/Magnetic CTAs
layout_css: Dark canvas inside ScrollSmoother (1.35 factor, data-speed 0.3-0.9 imagery) opening with SplitText rotationX(-80deg) headline, 170px radial-fill/magnetic CTA (0.7s/0.5s), and 250px video trigger.
responsive_rules: H1 scales down to 28-44px at 375px; effects disabled <1025px; cursors hidden <=1200px
anti_slop_notes: Enforce >= 7:1 text contrast and disable 3D rotation/magnetic tracking under reduced motion.

name: Swiper Emerald Marquee + 24-Logo Wall
layout_css: 108px #3BC77B Swiper freemode marquee (speed:2000ms/10000ms, delay:1) above 6x4 dark monochrome client grid entering with .fade_bottom (y:30 stagger 0.2s).
anti_slop_notes: Normalize client marks to uniform height and monochrome finish.

name: Sticky 15deg Preview + Ribbon-Wipe Service List
layout_css: Left sticky preview rotates to 15deg translate(60px,30px) in 0.5s with -26deg 175x70px green ribbon sweep; right rows enter sequentially x:-50->0 (.animation_home1_service).
responsive_rules: Below 1024px hides sticky preview frame and shows clean inline list
anti_slop_notes: Replace un-cleared mousemove setInterval leaks with CSS classes mirrored on :focus-visible.

name: Oversized 100px Bounce Count-Up Metrics Band
layout_css: 4-column strip entering with bounce drop (y:-100->0, 1.5s, stagger 0.3s) showcasing 100px tabular-nums counters above short descriptors.
anti_slop_notes: Include audited measurement scope note and never fabricate live telemetry.

name: Interactive Geo Coverage Map & Country Ticker
layout_css: SVG world map highlighting delivery regions in #3BC77B on #1E1E1E landmasses above horizontal country marquee.
anti_slop_notes: Pair SVG map with semantic region list for screen-reader accessibility.

name: MixItUp Portfolio Grid with Velocity SkewY & Slide Badge
layout_css: MixItUp 44px 5px-radius filter pills controlling 3-col cards that skewY (-15..15deg) on fast scroll and slide card labels right:-70->-50px on hover.
responsive_rules: 3 cols (29%) -> 2 cols (48.5%) -> 1 col (100% with label pinned visible)
anti_slop_notes: Pair active #65BC7B pills with #020617 ink and announce count via aria-live='polite'.

name: Video-Modal Testimonial Carousel with Cursor Play
layout_css: Swiper stage pairing zoom-in video poster (.animation_image_zoom scale 0.5->1 + +/-15px pointer parallax) and .cursor-testi 'Play' overlay beside executive quote.
responsive_rules: Video poster stacks over quote card mobile; cursor hides <=1200px
anti_slop_notes: Provide closed captions or transcript inside accessible <dialog> modal.

name: Staggered Software Product Catalog Grid
layout_css: Multi-product showcase pairing staggered horizontal showcase strip with 2/3-col product cards linking to deep-dive pages.
anti_slop_notes: Limit each product card to one primary interactive link covering title & preview.

name: 8-Card Capability & Multi-Portal Matrix
layout_css: Modular 4x2 feature card grid entering vertically (.animation__feature2) + 6 secondary chips + 3-col differentiators + role switcher tabs.
anti_slop_notes: Never duplicate cards across separate mobile/desktop markup trees.

name: Case Study Dossier: Meta, Challenge/Solution & Nav
layout_css: 3-part project dossier: 4-col metadata grid -> full-bleed scrub-zoom UI banner -> 2-col Challenge vs Solution split, feature carousel & Next/Prev nav.
anti_slop_notes: Document concrete engineering choices rather than generic claims.

name: Pre-Footer Consultation Band & 4-Col Footer
layout_css: Upper pre-footer callout with data-speed='0.2' backdrop imagery, 3 proof stats & embedded intake form above 4-col footer.
anti_slop_notes: Ensure all footer copy exceeds 4.5:1 contrast on #000000.
